# Private Chef Alexandros

> Private chef (Privatkoch) Alexandros Karimalis cooks dinners in homes, holiday apartments and chalets in Salzburg and the Salzburger Land, Austria. 2–20 guests, from €95 per person; tasting menus from €145. Alpine, Austrian, Greek and Mediterranean cuisine. Background: family restaurant on Ikaria (50 years), private chef in Mykonos villas, five-star resorts. Languages: English, German, Greek. Booking via WhatsApp +30 697 598 5318 or privatechefalexandros@gmail.com.
